note: Rewritten from the Russian original of Belyaeva (2004); the description is based on 11 soldier specimens and 8 alates, the wings of the latter being broken, so the venation is not recorded; synonymy, comparative literature and figure numbers are omitted. The original spells the specific name kuznetzovi, whereas the site uses kuznetsovi.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head quadrate, not constricted anteriorly, posterior margin rounded or slightly produced medially; in A. wroughtoni the head is distinctly trilobate and constricted anteriorly, and in A. deodarae the head is produced medially towards the thorax and not constricted anteriorly. Left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, tooth 2 flatter and less projecting than in wroughtoni; both of the 2 marginal teeth of the right mandible flat, with an undulating concavity in the middle, whereas in wroughtoni only tooth 2 has a concavity and in deodarae there is none. Pronotum oval; in wroughtoni trapezoidal to nearly oval, in deodarae hexagonal. Body size and mandibular shape close to wroughtoni, head shape close to deodarae.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Large, darkly coloured. Mandibles and frons to the antennal line black, vertex reddish brown, becoming yellowish brown towards the occiput; antennae brown, labrum yellowish brown, eyes cream; mandibles black, partly reddish brown at the base; pronotum pale yellow with dark margins, especially along the anterior margin; legs unevenly coloured, femora yellow, tibiae sometimes as dark as brown, tarsi pale brown. Head rectangular and flattened, sides parallel, not constricted anteriorly; posterior margin rounded, sometimes slightly produced medially. Frons with a small median rectangular depression dorsally. Eyes small, elongate, situated behind the antennae. Epicranial suture indistinct. Antennae 24-segmented, inserted on small elevations; segments 3 and 4, sometimes also segment 5, rectangular, the remaining segments oval and elongate. Labrum with parallel sides, anterior margin slightly rounded. Mandibles robust, teeth large: left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the first two well developed, tooth 1 truncate at the apex, tooth 2 broadly triangular; tooth 3 near the base, consisting of 2 small tubercles. Right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, tooth 1 broad with a double point, tooth 2 broad with an undulating concavity. Postmentum elongate, widest near the mouth, narrowing posteriorly, slightly swollen medially at its widest part. Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin nearly straight, posterior margin rounded; sometimes the anterior margin slightly convex, with a small median pit and a slight swelling, lateral angles rounded. Legs robust, tibiae with lateral and apical spines. Tarsi 5-segmented, only 4 segments visible in dorsal view. Cerci 6-segmented. Stout setae present. Measurements: head with mandibles 6.20–9.10, without mandibles 3.70–5.70; head width 3.60–4.90; postmentum length 2.50–4.50, maximum width 1.10–1.50, minimum width 0.60–0.80; pronotum length 1.10–1.90, width 2.50–3.40.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head reddish brown, postclypeus dark brown, mandibular articulations black, slightly paler towards the occiput; labrum and antennae yellowish brown, anteclypeus slightly paler; thoracic nota yellowish brown, each notum with a dark brown margin; wing scales brown; legs yellowish brown; abdominal tergites, sternites, cerci and stout setae the same colour as the legs. Head round, slightly narrowed and elongated at the occiput; sutures indistinct; vertex and subgenal region sharply separated by a black, ridged margin. Eyes large, black, slightly prominent, oval, somewhat reniform. Antennae 19–20-segmented, the basal 2–3 segments rectangular, the remaining circular and slightly elongate. Labrum completely covering the mandibles, sides slightly rounded, anterior margin gently rounded, with a row of setae. Mandibles trapezoidal; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the first two well developed and close to the apical tooth, tooth 3 near the base and separated from the molar plate by a ridge. Anterior margin of pronotum straight, sometimes with a small median pit; a longitudinal suture-like groove runs from the pit to the meso- and metanota; anterolateral angles rounded; anterior and lateral margins trough-like and upturned into a rim, gradually disappearing posteriorly. Meso- and metanota subequal, posterior margins shallowly concave. Fore wing scales reaching only the base of the hind wing scales; wing suture straight. Legs: femora straight, slightly widened apically; trochanters small; tibiae long and slender, lateral spines variable in number; tarsi 5-segmented, segment 2 visible only on the inner face, segment 5 the longest, with 2 claws and an arolium. Cerci 6–7-segmented; stout setae present only in males. Measurements: head to the apex of the labrum 2.65–3.15, to mandible base 2.25–2.50; head width including eyes 2.55–2.90, excluding eyes 2.40–2.65; labrum length 0.50–0.60; compound eye length 0.85–0.95, width 0.50–0.65; pronotum length 0.95–1.25, width 2.00–2.20.
